# node_modules/mochihttp

node:http shim: ClientRequest/IncomingMessage; get() over httpGet, request() over httpRequest — POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE with body verified (201, body echoed)

- **Orientation**: JS-first (Node.js NPM style)
- **Status**: verified — exercised against mbjs.exe

## Exports

```js
- `request`
- `get`
- `ClientRequest`
- `IncomingMessage`
- `STATUS_CODES`
- `METHODS`
```

Maintained by the SEVM project. Regenerated by `script/gen_manifests.py`.
